premise: To see the comet better in the long night, Leo and Maya drive the buggy out beyond the base's lights and sit in the dark, where its tail stretches across the stars.
inspiration: Andersen's 'The Nightingale', where the real bird outshines the jewelled one, turned: the real sky outshines every lamp, once you leave the lamps behind.
lesson: Sometimes you see more when you turn the lights down.

en-US.title: Lights Off for the Comet
en-US.text: {canvas:nightfall} Deep in the long Moon night, {woman:enter} Maya and {man:enter} Leo had a plan: comet-watching. But the lamps around the base were so bright that the sky looked dull and grey. {man:face sad} So out across the plain went the {buggy:enter} buggy, {buggy:go to crater} {man:go to crater} {woman:go to crater} all the way to the crater's edge, far from the lights. [whispers] They lay back in the dust and waited for their eyes to get used to the dark. {woman:pulse} {canvas:milkyway} Slowly, more stars came out. Then more. Then the pale river of the Milky Way. {woman:face surprised} And there, high over the ridge, hung the {comet:enter} {comet:float loop 0.2} comet. {comet:live hold} It glowed brighter and brighter, its tail stretching out across the stars. {woman:says} [in awe] “It's so much brighter out here.” {man:face happy} {man:says} [whispers] “That's the dark, helping.” They watched until their toes got chilly. {woman:tint #9AD0FF} {man:live} Then Leo checked his wrist: bedtime. [softly] {buggy:pulse} All the way home, nobody said a word. {woman:face happy} They didn't need to.

es-ES.title: Luces fuera para ver el cometa
es-ES.text: {canvas:nightfall} En plena noche lunar, {woman:enter} Maya y {man:enter} Leo tenían un plan: mirar el cielo. Pero las lámparas de la base brillaban tanto que el cielo parecía apagado y gris. {man:face sad} Así que el {buggy:enter} buggy cruzó la llanura {buggy:go to crater} {man:go to crater} {woman:go to crater} hasta el borde del cráter, lejos de las luces. [whispers] Se tumbaron en el polvo y esperaron a que sus ojos se acostumbraran a la oscuridad. {woman:pulse} {canvas:milkyway} Poco a poco salieron más estrellas. Y más. Y luego el río pálido de la Vía Láctea. {woman:face surprised} Y allí, muy alto sobre las montañas, estaba el {comet:enter} {comet:float loop 0.2} cometa. {comet:live hold} Brillaba cada vez más, con la cola extendida entre las estrellas. {woman:says} [in awe] «Aquí fuera brilla muchísimo más.» {man:face happy} {man:says} [whispers] «Es la oscuridad, que ayuda.» Miraron hasta que se les enfriaron los pies. {woman:tint #9AD0FF} {man:live} Luego Leo miró su muñeca: a dormir. [softly] {buggy:pulse} En todo el camino de vuelta, nadie dijo nada. {woman:face happy} No hacía falta.
